definition: a printed picture of a person or scene
description: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.
